entry_logic: On each new chart bar, use the current source's custom cumulative series: add tick volume when close>open, subtract it when close<open, and leave it unchanged on a doji. This is candle-body-signed tick volume, not conventional close-to-prior-close OBV.

Confirm fractal pivots using InpPivotStrength bars on both sides. For bearish divergence, the most recent confirmed pivot high must exceed the prior pivot high by more than _Point while the custom-series value at that pivot is lower by more than _Point. Bullish divergence reverses both comparisons at pivot lows. Each older pivot is searched backward within InpObvDivLookback.
Require close[1]>EMA(InpEmaTrendPeriod)[1] for a long and close[1]<EMA[1] for a short. Enter only when no owned symbol/magic position exists and the cooldown has elapsed.

Size with InpLots and the active H1 CKiyosakiRegime lot multiplier; calculate ATR(InpAtrPeriod)-scaled stop/target distances with active regime factors, normalize volume, and require projected-margin approval.
exit_logic: Attach a stop at ATR[1]*InpAtrSlMult*active regime SL multiplier and target at ATR[1]*InpAtrTpMult*active regime TP multiplier through MinatoTakeProfit.

There is no source-defined opposite-signal, EMA, or time exit. The margin-kill path closes positions matching both the configured magic number and symbol when positive account margin level falls below InpMarginKillLevel.
filters: The source's OBV-like input is signed by open-to-close candle body, whereas conventional OBV signs volume by close-to-previous-close. Preserve this distinction when rebuilding.
Pivots require right-side confirmation and are delayed by InpPivotStrength bars; verify pivot/OBV alignment and the in-place reversal plus ArraySetAsSeries indexing in Stage 2.
Verify EMA and ATR CopyBuffer physical/logical indexing; the current source reads index 1 after different copy start positions.
Require sufficient bars and finite valid OHLC, indicator, volume, ATR, lot, and margin data; skip entry when required data are unavailable.
Cooldown is measured from last successful trade time using InpMinBarsBetweenTrades*PeriodSeconds(PERIOD_CURRENT); only one owned position is permitted.

warmup.required_bars: At least max(100, 2*InpPivotStrength+InpObvDivLookback+5, InpEmaTrendPeriod+3, InpAtrPeriod+3) chart bars, plus 60 H1 bars for regime classification.
warmup.initialization: Require successful OHLC/tick-volume history build, confirmed pivot range, valid closed-bar EMA/ATR, and H1 regime data; skip signals on any missing or invalid input.

series.equation: Cumulative sum: +tick_volume[i] if close[i]>open[i], -tick_volume[i] if close[i]<open[i], unchanged if equal; source physically reverses the array and then sets series indexing.
A high/low pivot at shift s is confirmed when no strictly higher high/lower low occurs within InpPivotStrength bars on either side; eligible pivot shifts begin at InpPivotStrength+1.
EMA(close,InpEmaTrendPeriod) on PERIOD_CURRENT; source copies from start position 1 for three values and reads array index 1.
ATR(InpAtrPeriod) on PERIOD_CURRENT; source copies from start position 0 for three values and reads array index 1.
CKiyosakiRegime classification from up to 60 completed H1 highs, lows, and closes; the legacy source currently requests shift 0, which Stage 2 must change to closed data.

regimes.classification: Source CKiyosakiRegime on H1 OHLC maps to GREED, NEUTRAL, FEAR, or EXTREME_FEAR; selected regime triplet scales lot, stop, and target.

signals.long: Find most recent confirmed pivot low and preceding older confirmed pivot low within InpObvDivLookback; newer low < older low-_Point and custom_signed_tick_volume[newer] > custom_signed_tick_volume[older]+_Point; require close[1]>EMA[1].
signals.short: Find most recent confirmed pivot high and preceding older confirmed pivot high within InpObvDivLookback; newer high > older high+_Point and custom_signed_tick_volume[newer] < custom_signed_tick_volume[older]-_Point; require close[1]<EMA[1].
signals.conflict_policy: Do not enter if both directions qualify, any required data are invalid, an owned position is open, cooldown has not elapsed, volume is invalid, or projected-margin approval fails.

exits.take_profit: ATR[1]*InpAtrTpMult*selected regime TP multiplier through MinatoTakeProfit.
exits.time_stop: No source-defined time or signal exit; attached stop/target and magic+symbol-filtered margin-kill are the available exits.

execution.margin_check: Require MinatoAllowsProjectedMargin before entry; when positive account margin level is below InpMarginKillLevel, close only positions matching the configured magic number and _Symbol.
execution.volume_normalization: MinatoRegimeQuantity(InpLots, selected regime lot factor), clamped to broker min/max and floored to volume step.
execution.minimum_take_profit: Use MinatoTakeProfit for broker stop-distance compliance.

closed_bar_policy.rule: Signals are evaluated after NewBarClosed and intend closed-bar price, pivots, EMA, ATR, and custom-volume values; Stage 2 must reconcile the source's array orientation and CopyBuffer shifts before relying on alignment.

execution_contract.source_limit: The sources establish conventional OBV and MQL5 APIs, not the custom candle-body signed tick-volume rule, specific pivot thresholds, performance, or profitability.

stage2_requirements.note: Verify custom OBV array reversal/series indexing, CopyBuffer bar alignment, pivot confirmation and OBV-to-pivot alignment, and whether to retain candle-body-signed tick volume or replace it with conventional close-to-prior-close OBV. Preserve the disclosed long/short divergence and EMA filter, derive exact warmup, verify H1 regime closed-bar handling, and retain magic-filtered margin closes. Stages 2+ remain held.

risks: The file labels its series OBV, but the current implementation signs tick volume by close versus open rather than close versus previous close.
The custom series is reversed in place and then marked as series; its pivot index alignment needs runtime/source verification.
CopyBuffer values are physically ordered oldest-first; verify the source's EMA/ATR array index choices.
ATR, regime data, and pivots include code paths that may read shift 0; Stage 2 should ensure closed-bar reproducibility.
